title: Fair Fight
description:
Not every battle needs to be forced. §3Press K§r to enable PvP and allow yourself to fight other players who have also enabled it.

When PvP is active, a §3skull§r will appear below your screen as a reminder. Press §3K§r again to disable it. The keybind can be changed at any time through Minecraft's §3Key Binds§r settings.
